'''Gepko Sterringa''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Rogue 6 from Deventer, Neth. His slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" /> With [[Bas Van Zuilen]] (Red 62) he built and ran ryloth.com, a website for the Ryloth region's players.<ref name="decsq-prof-vanzuilen">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/vanzuilenbas.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Red 62 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001101104549/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/vanzuilenbas.html Internet Archive]</ref>
